name: 漕幫刀客

Each sprite no more than 65% cell width, generous 35px magenta gutters, NO touching neighbouring poses. No text, no grid lines, no scenery or floor. Adult anatomy, fine painterly details at 150px character height, NOT chibi, NOT 3D. SUBJECT: weathered adult Chinese male river bandit, black cloth headband, sleeveless rust-red vest over rough ivory shirt, dark grey trousers, rope belt and river boots, one broad ring-pommel knife. ALL POSES FACE LEFT. SIX ROWS OF SIX POSES: idle breathing; attack (pulls back knife then makes strong rising diagonal cut, anticipation, contact, follow-through); hit recoil and recovery; guard using actual equipped weapon; evasive crouch step and recovery; falling defeated, final frame lies motionless. Full body including all weapon tips in each cell, completely separated poses. Pure solid opaque magenta RGB background, no transparency.
